customs.name: Subscription permissions
customs.description: You need Contributor permissions on the target resource groups to deploy the data flow resources, and Owner or User Access Administrator permissions on the storage account to create role assignments. The deployment creates notification and dead-letter queues, creates or updates an Event Grid system topic and event subscription, and grants the first-party collector access to the blob container and queues. When Create is selected, it also grants the Event Grid system topic's managed identity Storage Queue Data Message Sender at storage-account scope. The Microsoft.EventGrid resource provider must be registered in the storage account's subscription.

customs.name: Event Grid delivery identity
customs.description: The connector enables system-assigned managed identity on a new or supplied existing Event Grid system topic. An existing topic must use the selected storage account as its source; its tags, attached user-assigned identities, and any existing system-assigned principal are preserved. The generated event subscription always uses system-assigned identity delivery. Choose Create to grant Storage Queue Data Message Sender on the destination storage account, or Use existing only when that same identity already has the required account-scoped permission. This identity is separate from the first-party collector application. The connector does not configure storage networking or Network Security Perimeter rules.

options.label: Create the required storage-account role assignment
Use an existing storage-account role assignment

parameters.content:
Choose **Create** for a new topic, a newly enabled system-assigned identity, or when that identity lacks **Storage Queue Data Message Sender** on the storage account. **Use existing** skips that grant; it does not discover or repair permissions. The collector's blob and queue grants are still deployed.

If Connect fails with **Managed Identity Authorization Error**, wait about five minutes and retry with the same alias, topic, and other values. RBAC propagation can take up to ten minutes. Do not recreate the topic or toggle its identity, as that changes the principal.

For storage in an Enforced Network Security Perimeter, separately allow Event Grid's subscription and the collector's service traffic as described in [Enable network security](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/enable-storage-network-security). This template does not change networking.
